registers.name: wd_version
registers.description: Watchdog version register. Identifies the fixed major and minor release values.

fields.name: major
fields.description:
Major version identifies the incompatible feature generation of this watchdog IP.

Usage: Read this field during driver initialization to confirm the supported register programming model.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFF Fixed major version is 0x1 (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: The value is fixed in hardware.

fields.name: minor
fields.description:
Minor version identifies the compatible revision of this watchdog IP.

Usage: Read this field during driver initialization for diagnostics and build identification.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFF Fixed minor version is 0x0 (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: The value is fixed in hardware.

registers.name: wd_cnt_ld
registers.description: Watchdog counter-load register. Stores the value used to reload the down-counter.

fields.name: load
fields.description:
Counter load value sets the unsigned count interval before a watchdog timeout.

Usage: Program the reload value before setting WDT_EN. A write also reloads the live counter but does not acknowledge an existing raw cause or escalation state.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF Counter reload value; timeout interval is LOAD + 1 WDT clock periods (reset value 0xFFFFFFFF).

Unit: WDT clock periods

Limits: None.

registers.name: wd_cnt_val
registers.description: Watchdog counter-value register. Reports the live down-counter value for software diagnostics.

fields.name: cnt_val
fields.description:
Counter value reports the current unsigned watchdog down-counter state sampled for APB readback.

Usage: Read this field to monitor watchdog progress or diagnose a pending timeout. The value can change between reads.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF Current down-counter value (reset value 0xFFFFFFFF).

Unit: WDT clock periods

Limits: The zero value may be brief because the counter reloads at timeout.

registers.name: wd_cnt_ctrl
registers.description: Watchdog control register. Enables counting and selects timeout and reset-pulse behavior.

fields.name: pulse_m1
fields.description:
Reset pulse width encodes the requested number of WDT clock periods minus one.

Usage: Program while WDT_EN is zero, before enabling the watchdog; the value is captured when a reset pulse starts.

Values:
0x00 to 0xFF Encodes 1 to 256 WDT periods as value plus one (reset value 0x00).

Unit: WDT clock periods

Limits: All encodings are valid; a write during an active pulse affects only a later pulse.

fields.name: dbgen
fields.description:
Debug halt control holds the watchdog counter and suppresses timeout processing when set.

Usage: Set only when software intends to halt the watchdog; clear it to resume. No live processor-debug input qualifies this control.

Values:
0x0 Normal counting behavior (reset value);
0x1 Counter halted.

Unit: none

Limits: This control is unconditional and independent of processor debug state.

fields.name: wdt_en
fields.description:
Watchdog enable starts or stops timeout counting independently from interrupt masking.

Usage: Program the load, pulse width, and reset response first. Clear to stop and reload the counter; set to begin a fresh interval.

Values:
0x0 Watchdog counting disabled (reset value);
0x1 Watchdog counting enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: Disabling clears escalation-pending state but preserves raw IRQ causes; an active reset pulse completes.

fields.name: resen
fields.description:
Reset enable permits a second unserviced real timeout to start the programmed reset pulse.

Usage: Set or clear while WDT_EN is zero when changing reset policy. IRQ enable does not affect this control.

Values:
0x0 Second-timeout reset disabled;
0x1 Second-timeout reset enabled (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: A reset pulse already in progress completes if this field is cleared.

registers.name: wd_irq_en
registers.description: Watchdog interrupt-enable register. Masks delivery of the matching raw timeout cause.

fields.name: timeout
fields.description:
Timeout interrupt enable controls delivery of the sticky timeout cause to status and the interrupt output.

Usage: Set or clear independently of WDT_EN. Enabling while raw timeout is already set asserts the masked status and interrupt.

Values:
0x0 Timeout interrupt masked (reset value);
0x1 Timeout interrupt enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: Does not gate counter operation, raw event capture, or reset escalation.

registers.name: wd_irq_raw
registers.description: Watchdog raw interrupt register. Retains timeout causes until software acknowledges them.

fields.name: timeout
fields.description:
Raw timeout cause records either a real first timeout or a software-injected timeout event.

Usage: Read for diagnosis. Write one to clear; clearing a real timeout also services and reloads the watchdog, while clearing an injection-only cause does not reload it.

Values:
0x0 No raw timeout cause (reset value);
0x1 Timeout cause pending.

Unit: none

Limits: A simultaneous new hardware event takes priority over software clear.

registers.name: wd_irq_sts
registers.description: Watchdog interrupt-status register. Reports the raw timeout cause after enable masking.

fields.name: timeout
fields.description:
Masked timeout status is the logical AND of the raw timeout cause and its interrupt enable.

Usage: Read to determine whether the timeout interrupt is currently enabled and pending; this field also drives the top-level interrupt.

Values:
0x0 No enabled timeout interrupt (reset value);
0x1 Raw timeout cause is enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: Read-only status; clearing requires W1C to the raw register.

registers.name: wd_irq_inj
registers.description: Watchdog interrupt-injection register. Generates a raw cause on a rising injection bit.

fields.name: timeout
fields.description:
Timeout injection creates a raw interrupt cause without changing the watchdog counter or escalation state.

Usage: Write zero, then one to inject a test event. Return the bit to zero before injecting another event.

Values:
0x0 Injection inactive (reset value);
0x1 Inject one raw timeout cause on the rising transition.

Unit: none

Limits: Injection tests IRQ handling only and cannot trigger watchdog reset escalation.

registers.name: wd_dbg_stat
registers.description: Watchdog debug-status register. Mirrors the configured counter halt control.

fields.name: dbg_stat
fields.description:
Debug status reports the DBGEN control value and does not sense processor debug mode.

Usage: Read to confirm whether the watchdog counter halt control is configured.

Values:
0x0 DBGEN clear (reset value);
0x1 DBGEN set and counter halted.

Unit: none

Limits: No live processor-debug input is present.
